title: Home looked strange after the Nordic countries
summary: Returning to Harlem felt dreary and unreal after Europe, and he praises Denmark.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, that was another story. Home looked

strange, very strange. Having been with Nordics a good deal of the time, you know, ha! -- Harlem looked very dreary. My own relatives and my own close friends looked very unreal, you know. There's something about the life in Europe that's just a little bit different than America.
And Denmark, I think, particularly... I always used to think that was very nice when I went there.
In those days... In Denmark we played the tip of Walborg(?). It was very nice. It was a nice country to play in.
The food was good. And the people are... I always thought the people were nice there.
